hints.title: Tokenization
hints.text: Split the input text string by whitespace into individual word tokens.

hints.title: Dictionary Translation
hints.text: Map each recognized number word to its corresponding decimal digit character.

hints.title: Concatenation
hints.text: Join the translated digit characters into a contiguous result string.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: N: length of input string s
complexity.notes: Linear tokenization and hash table translation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Repeated global substring replacements alter word substrings improperly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for token list and output buffer.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use whitespace splitting and constant-time dictionary lookup.
